scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @insurance/backend && npm run build -w @insurance/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently --names backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @insurance/backend" "npm run dev -w @insurance/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:integration -w @insurance/backend
scripts.test:coverage: npm run build:contracts && npm run test:coverage --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
